conversionNotes: No d6 roll wording appears in any Undead special rule, so no dice conversions were needed.
The PDF has no warband-wide special rules section; all rules are per fighter.

The equipment list is printed as 'used by Undead warbands' without naming fighters; usedBy lists the three heroes whose Weapons/Armour entries reference it. Zombies, Ghouls and Dire Wolves cannot take equipment.
Henchmen starting experience is 0 per the PDF; Zombies (No Brain) and Dire Wolves (Unliving) never gain experience. Ghouls can gain experience.
Dire Wolf A is printed as 1; the Charge rule gives 2 attacks on the turn they charge. A is not doubled in d12heim, so 2 on the charge stands as written.
